text:
Maria (CS): FYI renewal for FathomWorks in ~6 weeks. Noticed a sharp dip in API activity and a couple of inactive service keys. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/fathomworks
Ajay (AE): I had a procurement intro yesterday. They ran a trial with EchoAI and are asking for latency + cost comparisons. No signed PO yet. Lydia (champion) is still on the thread but hasn't been driving usage.
Maria (CS): Any personnel changes we should know about?
Ajay (AE): Procurement rep changed to Sam Carter. Engineering lead Miguel Ortiz is OOO (parental leave) so technical validation slowed.
Sylvie (AM): Triage suggestion:
1) 30m sync before week9s end (procurement + champion)
2) Provide a lightweight benchmark vs EchoAI for their primary flow
3) Offer a 14-day Dedicated eval (no infra changes on their side)
Can we prep collateral quickly?
Zoe (Enablement): I can pull a 1-pager + 4-slide benchmark by EOD tomorrow. I also have a one-page "what to monitor" for the eval.
PlatformBot: Metrics snapshot: active API keys: 39 -> 18 (30d), avg tokens/day: 1.05M -> 0.55M, 95th latency: +22ms after model pin change, errors: 2 client_timeouts in last 7d. Flag: usage_drop.
Maria (CS): Ajay, can you confirm which model EchoAI used? We should mirror compute profile for apples-to-apples.
Ajay (AE): They tested Echo-small for embeddings + chat. Looks like our rd-3b quantized profile will be closest. I'll confirm and note the prompt engineering differences.
Sylvie (AM): Prep items for the call:
- Quick usage timeline
- Cost & latency comparison (Zoe)
- Proposed eval terms + acceptance criteria
- Next step signoff (tech deep dive if they want to proceed)
Maria (CS): Drafted a short pre-call note Ajay can send:
"Hi Lydia & Sam, noticed lower activity and wanted to align before renewal. Can we do 30m Friday to walk a short benchmark and discuss a 14-day Dedicated eval to validate latency/cost for production traffic? No heavy ops required. Agenda attached."
Ajay (AE): Sending now. Invite: Fri 11am PT. Sent to Lydia, Sam, and Miguel (tentative).
Zoe (Enablement): Deck uploaded: https://drive.redwood/pres/fathomworks-dedicated-eval. Added sample contract addendum for temporary eval.
Maria (CS): If competitors come up, emphasize our routing/fallback, KV cache benefits, and predictable throughput of Dedicated.
Sylvie (AM): I'll draft the success criteria checklist for the eval (SLO targets, traffic mix, monitoring window).
PlatformBot: Created internal ticket CS-7901 and tagged account as renewal_risk:high.
Ajay (AE): I'll run the pre-call confirmations and surface any procurement asks. Will report back after Friday. :eyes:
Maria (CS): Thanks. I'll own follow-ups and convert outcomes into the renewal playbook ticket.
Zoe (Enablement): Happy to support the technical 15m if they accept the eval.
Maria (CS): Great team, keep updates in this thread.
